moduleSettings.faq.supportCard.title: Need more help?
moduleSettings.faq.usbEnabled.0.question: Can I connect my Trezor to Trezor Suite Lite?
moduleSettings.faq.usbEnabled.0.answer: Yes, you can connect your Trezor Hardware Wallet and use limited functionality. It is designed to work as a companion to the desktop/web version of Trezor Suite, but we will gradually add more features to make it a standalone application to manage your {coinLabel} funds with Trezor Hardware Wallet.
moduleSettings.faq.usbEnabled.1.question: What is the difference between Portfolio Tracker and Connected Trezor functionality?
moduleSettings.faq.usbEnabled.1.answer: Portfolio Tracker helps you stay in touch with your portfolio balances without having to connect your Trezor device. Simply sync your coin addresses and you can keep track of your balances on the go. You can also combine coin addresses from multiple wallets or Trezor devices to track your whole portfolio in one place. Connected Trezor allows you to manage your funds associated with your Trezor device. You can verify receive addresses and check your balances and transactions. However, if you disconnect the Trezor, you will no longer see the data from the Trezor device.
moduleSettings.faq.usbEnabled.2.question: What is public key? (XPUB) or a receive address?
moduleSettings.faq.usbEnabled.2.answer: An XPUB is a master public key for hierarchical deterministic wallets like bitcoin, generating multiple child keys and receive addresses for improved privacy. Ethereum uses a single, unchanging address for all transactions. For Ethereum, share only your address, while keeping your private key secure.
moduleSettings.faq.usbEnabled.3.question: My Trezor device can’t connect
moduleSettings.faq.usbEnabled.3.answer.1: Use a different USB data cable
moduleSettings.faq.usbEnabled.3.answer.3: Enable connection for Trezor Suite Lite via phone system message
moduleSettings.faq.usbEnabled.4.question: What version of Trezor device Firmware Trezor Suite Lite supports?
moduleSettings.faq.usbEnabled.5.question: Why don’t I see my coin listed?
moduleSettings.faq.usbEnabled.5.answer: Trezor Suite Lite currently supports a limited number of cryptocurrencies. If your coin is not listed, it may not be compatible with the app. However, Trezor regularly adds support for new coins, so check back periodically to see which coins have been added.
moduleSettings.faq.usbEnabled.6.question: What does the graph display?
moduleSettings.faq.usbEnabled.6.answer: The graph in Trezor Suite Lite displays the price history of your portfolio’s synced assets over specified time period. You can adjust the time period by selecting a different range on the bottom of the graph.
moduleSettings.faq.usbEnabled.7.question: What is View-only?
moduleSettings.faq.usbEnabled.7.answer: Even when your Trezor device is disconnected, you can still keep track of your balances with the View-Only. This feature provides peace of mind by allowing you to monitor your funds without compromising security. Plus no more waiting for retrieving all the assets and balances while connecting your Trezor device.
moduleSettings.faq.usbDisabled.0.questio: What is public key? (XPUB) or a receive address?
moduleSettings.faq.usbDisabled.0.answer: An XPUB is a master public key for hierarchical deterministic wallets like bitcoin, generating multiple child keys and receive addresses for improved privacy. Ethereum uses a single, unchanging address for all transactions. For Ethereum, share only your address, while keeping your private key secure.
moduleSettings.faq.usbDisabled.1.questio: Can I connect my Trezor to Trezor Suite Lite?
moduleSettings.faq.usbDisabled.1.answer: No, it is not possible. It is designed to work as a companion to the desktop/web version of Trezor Suite as a way to keep up with your Trezor portfolio on the go.
moduleSettings.faq.usbDisabled.2.questio: How do I send {coinLabel} in Trezor Suite Lite?
moduleSettings.faq.usbDisabled.2.answer: Trezor Suite Lite is a watch-only portfolio tracker, which means it is designed to help you monitor your cryptocurrency holdings and transactions. Unfortunately, it is not currently possible to send {coinLabel} using Trezor Suite Lite. To send {coinLabel}, use the full version of Trezor Suite with your Trezor hardware wallet. This will provide you with the necessary security and functionality to manage and perform transactions with your cryptocurrencies.
moduleSettings.faq.usbDisabled.3.questio: Why don’t I see my coin listed?
moduleSettings.faq.usbDisabled.3.answer: Trezor Suite Lite currently supports a limited number of cryptocurrencies. If your coin is not listed, it may not be compatible with the app. However, Trezor regularly adds support for new coins, so check back periodically to see which coins have been added.
moduleSettings.faq.usbDisabled.4.answer: The graph in Trezor Suite Lite displays the price history of your portfolio’s synced assets over specified time period. You can adjust the time period by selecting a different range on the bottom of the graph.
moduleSettings.faq.usbDisabled.5.questio: Why is the balance displayed in Trezor Suite different from the balance displayed in Trezor Suite Lite?
moduleSettings.faq.usbDisabled.5.answer: Balances may mismatch due to improper syncing of all assets and account types, or pending transactions. Ensure you have synced all your assets correctly and check for any pending transactions to resolve the discrepancy.

moduleDeviceOnboarding.walletCreationScr: Never store your wallet backup anywhere digital—no photos, clouds, USBs, or emails.

A wallet backup is a list of words (called a share) which allows you to recover access to your assets if your Trezor hardware wallet is lost, stolen, or damaged.

You can also use it to move your assets to a new hardware wallet.

Get a good pen and your wallet backup card from your Trezor’s packaging.

Write down the words in the exact order shown on your Trezor. The sequence of words is important to get right.

Verify each word before proceeding to the next.

After writing your wallet backup, you'll verify it's correct. Your Trezor will display a random selection of words along with their correct positions.

Compare them to your wallet backup card and select the matching word for each position.
